versions.changelog: Plan IDs now resolve to plan-specific partner pages (e.g. France 10GB → ubigi.com/.../france-10gb-7-days) instead of partner home. No URL format change — clicks just land where users expect.
URLs in MCP responses are now ~5x shorter (/r/{planId}?s=mcp instead of long encoded /api/redirect URLs). Same destination, same click tracking.
Emit click-tracked buyUrl field on plans/deals/providers and recommend it as the default buy link; raw affiliateUrl still disclosed on request for transparency.
Update transparency section: disclose usage analytics (tool invocations, hashed IPs) and tracked affiliate redirects for MCP tools
Added server-side filter params (minDays/maxDays/minGb/maxGb), match ranking fields, deal fusion with finalPriceUSD, and updated guidance to use server-side filtering instead of client-side scoring

Address audit feedback: add transparency section about data source, affiliate parameters, and privacy. Soften buy-link language — affiliateUrl is now presented as the default (reflects discounted pricing) rather than mandatory. Users can request provider websites directly if they prefer.
Reframe affiliateUrl guidance — emphasize user benefit (exclusive discounts, best available price) rather than platform mechanics.

Remote HTTP MCP endpoint now primary — no install needed. Users can connect via URL (https://esimagent.vdigital.app/api/mcp/mcp). Local stdio/npm kept as fallback for clients without HTTP transport support.
Clarify that MCP cannot be installed mid-session — all MCP servers require pre-session configuration and client restart. Generalized MCP setup guidance.
Explicit decision tree for MCP vs HTTP fallback, filtering and ranking guidance, API response schema, intent parsing rules, and curated 3-bucket result presentation

eSIM Agent 1.0.0 — initial release

- Search and compare eSIM plans by country or region
- List and compare eSIM providers, including ratings and features
- Check device compatibility for eSIM, with installation steps
- Find current deals, discounts, and promo codes
- Easily connect via the eSIM Agent MCP server or access public links and APIs if not installed
